cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I'm a physician in Osaka, Japan.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I specialize in diabetes and I have been practicing medicine for

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: about 24 years.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I now run my own community clinic where I see many different

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: health problems, but much of my work is with chronic

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and obesity.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: And it's a very busy clinic.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I see around 80 patients a day and sometimes more than 90.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: So conversations about change are not separate intervention for

cues.speaker: MIXED
cues.text: me. They are part of all -in -all clinical care every day.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_02
cues.text: So eating, activity,

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: medication, sleep, stress, work, and motivational interviewing has

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: become so important in my practice.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I first came across MI when I was working in diabetes

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: and metabolic department, and I worked in outpatient

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: clinic at a university hospital.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: At that time, I thought that if patients did not change their

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: lifestyle, maybe they simply did not have enough

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: medical knowledge.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: So I tried very hard to explain.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I talked about diabetes and its complications and risks, and

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: I asked many questions.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: And also, I tried to listen very carefully, too.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: So from my point of view, I was, I supposed to be a good

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: doctor, but sometimes I spent more than 30 minutes with one patient.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: So even we often had good relationships, many people still

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: did not make changes and my clinics ran late.

cues.speaker: SPEAKER_01
cues.text: Then I became exhausted.
